title: sambucus racemosa f. nuda
intro: Sambucus racemosa f. nuda, commonly known as the American dwarf or naked elderberry, is a plant species that belongs to the Sambucus genus. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as colds and flu. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus racemosa f. nuda are attributed to its antiviral, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in alleviating symptoms like cough, fever, and sore throat. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, terpenes, and alkaloids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
